description: 12-week plan for athletes with running base (30+ min) and functional fitness background.

days.cardioNotes: Easy conversational pace. Focus on building aerobic base.

exercises.name: SkiErg
exercises.equipmentNeeded: SkiErg machine. If no SkiErg: rowing machine (same distance) or assault bike (2x distance)
exercises.notes: 500m intervals @ moderate pace. Focus on technique: engage core, drive with hips and lats. 2 min rest between sets.

exercises.name: Rowing
exercises.equipmentNeeded: rowing machine
exercises.notes: 500m intervals @ moderate pace. Focus on leg drive and catch position. 2 min rest between sets.

exercises.name: Wall Balls
exercises.equipmentNeeded: 6kg/9kg wall ball. If no wall ball target: thrusters with dumbbell
exercises.notes: Women 6kg, Men 9kg. Focus on full depth squat and explosive hip drive. 90sec rest.

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.equipmentNeeded: none
exercises.notes: Chest to ground, jump and clap overhead. Focus on maintaining pace. 90sec rest.

days.cardioNotes: Warmup 10min easy, then 6 x 800m @ 8K race pace with 90sec jog recovery, cooldown 10min easy.
Easy walk or complete rest. Listen to your body.

exercises.name: Sled Push
exercises.equipmentNeeded: Sled with 78kg/102kg (Women/Men). If no sled: prowler, heavy farmers carry, or resistance band sprints
exercises.notes: 50m pushes @ 75% race weight. Focus on driving through legs, low body position. 2min rest.

exercises.name: Sled Pull
exercises.equipmentNeeded: Sled with 78kg/102kg (Women/Men). If no sled pull: heavy rope pulls or bent over rows
exercises.notes: 50m pulls @ 75% race weight. Hand over hand pull walking backwards. 2min rest.

exercises.name: Farmers Carry
exercises.equipmentNeeded: 2x24kg/2x32kg kettlebells (Women/Men). Use heaviest dumbbells/kettlebells available
exercises.notes: 100m carries. Focus on upright posture, engaged core, quick steps. 90sec rest.

exercises.name: Sandbag Lunges
exercises.equipmentNeeded: 20kg sandbag. If no sandbag: goblet lunges with heavy dumbbell
exercises.notes: 50m walking lunges. Bag on shoulders. Focus on knee tracking and upright torso. 2min rest.

exercises.equipmentNeeded: none
exercises.notes: Burpee + broad jump forward. Focus on explosive jump. 2min rest.
